title: [Classic Long-Form RPG] The story now runs all the way to the end, but…

blocks.source: 【王道長編RPG】ストーリーは最後まで通ったけれど……
blocks.translation: [Classic Long-Form RPG] The story now runs all the way to the end, but…

blocks.source: ラストダンジョンのマップが完成。ラストバトル～エンディングのイベントも申し訳程度ながら完成しました。
blocks.translation: The final dungeon map is complete. The events from the final battle through the ending are also complete, albeit in a bare-bones form.

blocks.source: 画像は物語終盤とは関係なく、序盤の湿地林的な何かです。途中、水の中に入ったりするダンジョンが何となく好きです。でも、そんなのばかりやたら作り過ぎてしまった気がしないでもない。
blocks.translation: The image has nothing to do with the latter part of the story; it is some kind of marshy forest from the early part. I have a vague fondness for dungeons where you go into the water along the way. Though I can't help feeling that I may have made far too many of them.

blocks.source: ストーリー制作の合間にマップチップのクオリティを向上させています。制作が長期に渡りすぎたせいで、初期に描いたものと最近描いたもので、出来にバラつきが出るのも悩み。柱とか扉とか、しっくりこないのでいい加減に直したい……。
blocks.translation: In between working on the story, I have been improving the quality of the map tiles. Since development has gone on for so long, one problem is that the quality varies between things I drew early on and those I drew recently. The pillars and doors, among other things, don't feel quite right, so I really want to fix them already…

blocks.source: というわけで、エンディングまで通しで物語を見れるようになったというものの、色々と問題が山積しています。怒涛の辻褄合わせ及び問題点の解消が急務です。そのためにも、まずは問題を洗い出してみましょう。
blocks.translation: So, although I can now play through the story all the way to the ending, I have a mountain of problems to deal with. It is urgent that I make a furious effort to resolve inconsistencies and fix the issues. To that end, let's start by identifying the problems.

blocks.source: 登場人物の両親が曖昧
blocks.translation: The protagonists' parents are vague

blocks.source: 主人公を始めとした登場人物の両親に付いて、設定あるいは存在そのものが曖昧なものがいくらかあるというのが第一の問題です。
blocks.translation: The first problem is that the settings or even the very existence of the parents of several characters, including the protagonist, are vague.

blocks.source: そう言えばゲーム・漫画・アニメなどで、主要人物である少年少女の両親が描かれないことを指摘されてたりしますね。都合良く死んでたり、都合良く海外に仕事に行ってたりで、作中では一切触れられず。あるいは存在そのものすら触れられない場合もあります。
blocks.translation: Come to think of it, games, manga, and anime are sometimes criticized for not depicting the parents of the boys and girls who are major characters. They conveniently die or conveniently go abroad for work, and are never mentioned at all in the story. In some cases, their very existence is never even addressed.

blocks.source: 製作する側になってみるとその理由がよく分かりますが、ぶっちゃけ面倒だからです。作者たるもの自分が描きたいと思ったものに焦点を当て、物語を作成するのが当然のこと。別に親子愛のストーリーを描きたいわけでも何でもなければ、親の存在は不要なわけです。関係無い不要な登場人物を増やすと、その説明をしなければなりません。グラフィックを用意したり、セリフを費やしたりするのも手間です。
blocks.translation: Once you try being the person making the work, you understand the reason quite well: frankly, it's a hassle. An author is naturally going to focus on what they want to depict and create the story around it. If you aren't trying to depict a story about parental love or anything like that, there is no need for the parents to exist. Adding irrelevant, unnecessary characters means you have to explain them. Preparing graphics and spending dialogue on them is also a lot of work.

blocks.source: で、この作品ではどうか。一応主人公の両親など薄っすらと設定は考えていましたが、あまりストーリーに活かせる余地はなく中途半端です。意味もなく死んでることにすると適当感は拭えない。かと言って、過去の回想などを使って、詳細に描くのもダルいです。正直、僕としては特に焦点を当てて描く必要を感じないので、どう処理しようかという感じです。
blocks.translation: So, what about this work? I had at least vaguely thought up settings for the protagonist's parents and such, but they are half-baked because there is little room to make use of them in the story. Simply making them dead for no reason would still feel arbitrary. On the other hand, depicting them in detail through flashbacks and the like would be tedious. Honestly, I don't feel the need to focus on them in particular, so I'm wondering how to handle them.

blocks.source: それ以外にも、特に何の説明もなく両親のいないキャラが複数いるのは困りもの。とりあえず、幾人かはモブ同然の役割で置いておこうかと思います。途中のイベントに何らかの形で組み込めれば理想的なのですが……。
blocks.translation: Besides that, it is troublesome that there are several characters without parents and no particular explanation for it. For now, I think I will leave some of them in roles that are practically those of background characters. Ideally, I would like to incorporate them into an event somewhere along the way, though…

blocks.source: ラスボスなど敵関連の設定が曖昧
blocks.translation: The settings for the enemies, including the final boss, are vague

blocks.source: ラスボスは比較的設定がしっかりしている部類ですが、それでも時系列上に穴があったり、途中の行動の目的が曖昧だったりする部分があります。悪役だからといって「むしゃくしゃして町を襲った。今は反省している」では駄目ですよね。やはり、この辺もちゃんとせねば。
blocks.translation: The final boss is among the more firmly established characters, but even there are gaps in the chronology and parts where the purpose behind certain actions along the way is unclear. Just because he's a villain, you can't have him say, "I attacked the town because I was frustrated. I regret it now." Right? I really need to get this area sorted out properly too.

blocks.source: 登場はするが退場の無い敵キャラがいる
blocks.translation: There are enemy characters who appear but never leave the story

blocks.source: これは↑よりも酷い。あまり重要で無い敵キャラを作ったのですが、決着を付けるイベントを作らないまま放置していました。このままでは、あまりにも位置付けが中途半端なので、途中で処理するイベントを用意せねばなりません。
blocks.translation: This is even worse than ↑. I created some enemies who aren't particularly important, but left them hanging without creating an event to bring things to a conclusion. As things stand, their role is far too half-baked, so I need to prepare an event to deal with them somewhere along the way.

blocks.source: 時系列上、途中の行動が不明なキャラがいる
blocks.translation: There is a character whose actions midway through the chronology are unknown

blocks.source: 作中において、序盤と終盤だけ目立った出番があるというサブキャラ。その途中に何をやっているのかが全くもって不明です。間を埋めねばなりません。
blocks.translation: There is a supporting character who has prominent appearances only at the beginning and end of the story. What they are doing in between is completely unknown. I need to fill in the gap.

blocks.source: 仲間の旅の動機が不明
blocks.translation: The party members' reasons for traveling are unclear

blocks.source: 仲間が主人公達に付いてくる動機が一部弱いものがあります。１人～２人はもう「面白そうだから」とかそんなレベルで良い気がしますが、できればもう少し補足したいところ。動機付けは大事です。
blocks.translation: Some of the party members have weak motivations for accompanying the protagonists. I feel that for one or two of them, something on the level of "because it sounds interesting" might be enough, but if possible, I would like to supplement that a little more. Motivation is important.

blocks.source: こうしてみると、比較的単純なストーリーにしたつもりなのに、色々と積み上げていった結果、案外複雑になっていることが分かります。いえ、僕が適当なのが悪いのですが。
blocks.translation: Looking at it this way, I realize that although I intended to make a relatively simple story, it has become surprisingly complicated as a result of building up one thing after another. No, it's my own fault for being so careless.

blocks.source: 今年中にはどうにかして、来年からはゲームシステム部分に進みたいと思っているのですが、どうなることやら。
blocks.translation: I hope to somehow get it done this year and move on to the game system next year, but who knows how things will turn out.
